title: Enroll in E-Verify and verify new hires (Georgia)
authority: Georgia employment eligibility law / U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
description: Georgia requires employers with more than ten employees to register and participate in E-Verify as a condition of obtaining or renewing a business license.

appliesWhen.description: 11 or more employees in the state

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: No fine is stated; local governments enforce the rule by refusing to issue or renew business licenses without an E-Verify affidavit.
